spec: ids.effect_hash -> lines 'e' US target US description, 'c' US condition, 'r' US rate, 's' US scaling, joined (sha256 hex)

vectors.name: proc_water_dragon_slayer_xl
effects: increases physical and magic ability power by 4xl+.
increases damage when using a physical or magic attack ability by s+.
increases physical and magic attack ability success value by m.
conditions: when a physical or magic attack ability is used.
scaling: ability power scales with the number of water elemental weapons equipped up to a max of 5xl+ (gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).
activation rate scales with the number of water elemental weapons equipped up to a max of xl (gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).

vectors.name: proc_mastery_over_dark_xl
effects: reduces physical and magic damage taken by l+.
increases status ailment resistance by xxl.
conditions: when physical or magic damage is taken.
scaling: damage reduction scales with the number of dark elemental helm/hat/armor/clothing type gear pieces equipped up to a max of xxl (gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).
activation rate scales with the number of dark elemental helm/hat/armor/clothing type gear pieces equipped up to a max of xl (gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).

vectors.name: passive_eclipses_blessing
effects: status ailment resistance boosted by 45 when equipped in the main slot.

vectors.name: passive_eins_schwert
effects: if your class is a soldier class, reduces fire unison attack and great spirit unison attack damage by 90% when equipped in the main slot.
